questions.passage:
(A) Historians often study the biases hidden in the historical <u>record</u> of the past.
(B) She used her phone to <u>record</u> the beautiful song at the concert.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 record의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A): 기록(과거의 역사적 '기록') - (B): 녹음하다(노래를 '녹음하다')
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A): 녹음하다 - (B): 기록: (A)는 역사적 '기록(명사)'을 뜻함

❌ ② (A): 경신하다 - (B): 녹음하다: (A)는 '기록을 세우다'가 아니라 명사 '기록'

✅ ③ (A): 기록 - (B): 녹음하다: (A)는 역사적 '기록', (B)는 노래를 '녹음하다'로 정확 ←정답

❌ ④ (A): 기록 - (B): 경신하다: (B)는 '기록을 경신하다'가 아니라 동사 '녹음하다'
det.tip: the historical record(기록) / record the song(녹음하다)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a small group of people who hold a lot of power, wealth, or high status in a society"

det.korean: elites(엘리트): 사회에서 많은 권력·부·높은 지위를 가진 소수 집단
det.analysis:
❌ ① beginners: 초보자. 권력·지위 정의와 무관

❌ ② customers: 고객. 정의와 무관

❌ ③ strangers: 낯선 사람. 정의와 무관

✅ ④ elites: 사회에서 권력·부·높은 지위를 가진 소수 집단이라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
det.tip: elites = a small group with a lot of power, wealth, or high status

questions.passage: Even when they did produce documentation, these materials rarely ended up in archives where they could be __________ (preserve) and made available to researchers. Because of such biases in the historical record, social historians have to be very creative in their work.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 수동태 과거분사형. preserve(동사) → preserved(보존되는)
det.analysis: 조동사 could 뒤에서 'be + 과거분사'의 수동태를 이루어야 한다. 자료가 '보존되는' 대상이므로 수동형 preserved가 와야 하며, 뒤의 made available과 and로 병렬 연결된다.

questions.passage: Because of such biases in the __________ (history) record, social historians have to be very creative in their work. Like other historians, social historians analyze textual sources produced by government officials, employers, and other elites.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 형용사형. history(명사) → historical(역사적인)
det.analysis: 뒤의 명사 record를 수식해야 하므로 명사 history가 아니라 형용사 historical로 바꿔야 한다. 'the historical record'는 '역사적 기록'이라는 뜻의 명사구가 된다.

questions.passage: Yet rather than simply take such sources at face value, they read them “against the grain”. Like all historians, social historians draw from a variety of primary sources. Social history often emphasizes ordinary people rather than elites. Yet, in most places and times, non-elites lacked access to education and, thus, did not produce substantial amounts of documentation. Even when they did produce documentation, these materials rarely ended up in archives where they could be preserved and made available to researchers. Because of such biases in the historical record, social historians have to be very creative in their work. Like other historians, social historians analyze textual sources produced by government officials, employers, and other elites. So, for example, a social historian will read __________ not only for the “facts” provided by slaveowners; she will also examine the silences, interruptions, rumors, and other details that offer hints about the enslaved peoples’ attitudes and actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사회사가는 노예주가 제공한 '사실'을 얻기 위해 '법적 문서(legal documents)'를 읽는다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① legal documents: 노예주가 남긴 '사실'을 담은 '법적 문서'를 읽는다는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ② private diaries: 개인 일기. 노예주가 제공한 공식 '사실'이라는 근거와 어긋남

❌ ③ fictional novels: 허구 소설. 역사 사료로 부적합

❌ ④ weather reports: 일기예보. 문맥 무관
det.tip: read ______ not only for the facts provided by slaveowners → legal documents(법적 문서)

questions.passage: Yet rather than simply take such sources at face value, they read them “against the grain”. Like all historians, social historians draw from a variety of __________. Social history often emphasizes ordinary people rather than elites. Yet, in most places and times, non-elites lacked access to education and, thus, did not produce substantial amounts of documentation. Even when they did produce documentation, these materials rarely ended up in archives where they could be preserved and made available to researchers. Because of such biases in the historical record, social historians have to be very creative in their work. Like other historians, social historians analyze textual sources produced by government officials, employers, and other elites. So, for example, a social historian will read legal documents not only for the “facts” provided by slaveowners; she will also examine the silences, interruptions, rumors, and other details that offer hints about the enslaved peoples’ attitudes and actions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 모든 역사가처럼 사회사가도 다양한 '1차 사료(primary sources)'를 활용한다는 맥락이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① secret codes: 비밀 암호. 역사 연구 자료로 부적합

✅ ② primary sources: 역사가가 끌어오는 다양한 '1차 사료'라는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ③ personal feelings: 개인 감정. 사료가 아님

❌ ④ random samples: 무작위 표본. 문맥 무관
det.tip: draw from a variety of ______ → primary sources(1차 사료)
